mel: FYI bringing up Fauston13b (HF) for our internal translate/qa suite. small int4 run shows divergent answers vs fp16 on prompts with mixed English + code-switch Spanish. anyone seen a qwen/gemma cross-compat issue like this?
chang: can you paste the convert flags + a failing example?
mel: convert: `./bin/convert --model fauston13b --quant int4 --scheme ptq --out /tmp/fauston-q4`
example prompt: "Translate: ¿Df3nde puedo encontrar the API docs for the new SDK?"
- fp16 answer: "Puedes encontrar los doc en https://... "
- int4 answer: "You can find the docs at https://... (but misorders tokens leading to incomplete sentence)
olga: that symptom often comes from tokenizer normalization or a vocab aliasing where accent tokens split differently. any tokenizer warnings?
mel: log: ```
WARN tokenizer.vocab_size=50258 (card:50257)
WARN alias <U+200C> mapped -> 50257
WARN rotary.headwise=true in model, converter emitted shared_scale
```
chang: two parallel issues then: vocab alias (zero-width non-joiner) shifting indices; and rotary headwise->shared collapsing. headwise rotary often fixes alignment for mixed-script.
mel: re-converted with flags: `--preserve-eos --preserve-rotary-headwise --tokenizer-normalize nfkc`
quick smoke: ```
fp16 chrF: 0.784
int4 default: 0.712
int4 headwise+nfkc: 0.779
```
chang: looks like headwise + correct normalization recovers quality. please run token_map roundtrip to ensure no remap.
mel: ran `tools/token_map --roundtrip /tmp/fauston-q4b` -> found `50257 -> 50258 (mapped due to ZWNJ collision)`. fixed by preserving tokenizer ordering and adding explicit `--tokenizer-normalize nfkc`.
olga: next steps: add a converter preflight that compares hf card fields (vocab_size, tokenizer.normalization, rotary.headwise) and fails with recommended flags; also add small bilingual fuzz corpus (EN+ES + ZWNJ/ZWJ) to conversion CI.
chang: also queue a bench across 6 seeds for longctx kvcache alignment plots and headwise cosine similarity between fp16 and int4 keys. if any head < 0.98, fail the job unless opt-in override.
ops-bot: queued bench 9976543220 for branch `onboard/fauston-tokenizer-rotary-fixes`. status: queued.
mel: opened PR 4432 with preflight, fuzz corpus (8k), and doc blurb in `docs/model_onboard.md` describing the common gotchas: vocab aliasing (ZWJ/ZWNJ), encoder normalizations, rotary headwise vs shared, proj_order packing.
chang: nice. one more: add metadata fields to the model card: `original_vocab_size`, `tokenizer_fingerprint`, `conversion_flags` so future diffs are obvious.
mel: will do. thanks all — will follow-up when bench finishes. :thumbsup:
